name: Track the aLIC
summary: Tracks the anterior limb of the internal capsule (aLIC) with MRtrix3 ensemble tractography between FreeSurfer-derived anatomical landmarks and segments it into superior and inferior components, outputting a .tck and a WMC.
description: Identifies the anterior limb white matter volume from FreeSurfer landmarks, runs targeted ensemble tractography (parameter sweep over curvature, lmax and tracking algorithms) with MRtrix3, and segments the result into a canonical superior and a non-canonical inferior aLIC component. Use it to study the morphology, trajectory and connectivity of the aLIC. DWI, T1w and FreeSurfer output must be preprocessed and aligned to one another; runtime grows with the number of streamlines requested.

inputs.description: Preprocessed DWI with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Aligned with the T1w and FreeSurfer output.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output of the subject, used to locate the aLIC landmarks.
Preprocessed T1-weighted image used for 5ttgen tissue segmentation.

outputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) from the targeted ensemble tracking.
White matter classification with the superior and inferior aLIC components of the tractogram.
